recipes.description: Extruded from the page: same surface, soft light and shadow pair, no border
Extruded; pressed shows an inset pair and a bolder label (never shadow alone)
Inset into the page, keeping its border

a11y: Controls keep their borders (WCAG 1.4.11); only cards and table wrappers rely on shadows
The pressed state also changes the label weight, so it is not conveyed by shadow alone
Focus ring strengthened to the thick border width
Under the contrast theme, forced colors and prefers-contrast: more, borders come back and the soft shadows go
